content: Open WebUI: Settings > Admin > Connections, Add Connection with base URL + key, URL autosuggests known providers, models auto-detected via /models with a Model IDs allowlist fallback; Save verifies. Cherry Studio: per-provider key with a 'check' button, model list must be built by clicking + next to discovered models or '+ Add' a model ID by hand, Manage to edit/delete. LibreChat: librechat.yaml custom endpoints, apiKey via env var reference, models.default list or fetch:true to pull /models; Anthropic-native endpoints do not fetch. Obsidian Copilot: Set Keys dialog, Add Custom Model (name + provider), Test Connection button, self-host templates for Ollama/LM Studio with default local URLs and no key. Zed: Settings > AI > LLM Providers, keys in system keychain, auto-discovers Ollama/LM Studio models, favourite models, Add Provider for OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoints (name, URL, model id, context window).
